title: Decision language models as affordable and rapid alternatives to LLM judges of clinical generative AI
abstract: arXiv:2610.28826v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Automated judges of clinical artificial intelligence (AI) outputs are necessary, but large language model (LLM) judges are costly and slow at scale. We compared Jev, a decision language model that returns structured judgments, with frontier and open-weight LLM judges in four use cases. On 118 pediatric answers, Jev's agreement with physicians' ordinal quality ratings (Gwet's AC2 0.50; expected score 0.53) matched or exceeded that of seven of 12 LLM judges, including frontier models, Claude Opus 5.5 (0.49) and GPT-6 (0.38). On physician-graded binary HealthBench criteria, Jev matched or exceeded four of six LLM judges. On MedHELM's open-ended tasks, Jev's agreement with a three-LLM jury approached or exceeded the jurors' internal agreement. On HealthBench Professional, Jev matched the benchmark's reference judge, GPT-5.4, on 91% of criteria (other judges, 91-93%). Frontier judges cost 73-294 times more than Jev and took 7-57 times longer.

translated_title: 决策语言模型：临床生成式AI的大语言模型评判者的经济高效且快速的替代方案
translated_abstract: 对临床人工智能（AI）输出的自动化评判十分必要，但大语言模型（LLM）评判者在大规模应用时成本高昂且速度缓慢。我们在四个应用场景中，将Jev——一种返回结构化判断的决策语言模型——与前沿模型及开放权重LLM评判者进行了比较。在118份儿科回答上，Jev与医生序数质量评分的一致性（Gwet's AC2为0.50；期望得分为0.53）达到或超过了12个LLM评判者中的7个，其中包括前沿模型Claude Opus 5.5（0.49）和GPT-6（0.38）。在由医生评级的HealthBench二元标准上，Jev达到或超过了6个LLM评判者中的4个。在MedHELM的开放式任务上，Jev与由三个LLM组成的评审团的一致性接近或超过了评审团成员之间的内部一致性。在HealthBench Professional上，Jev在91%的标准上与该基准的参考评判者GPT-5.4保持一致（其他评判者为91-93%）。前沿评判者的成本是Jev的73-294倍，耗时是Jev的7-57倍。
tldr: 一种名为Jev的决策语言模型在评估临床生成式AI输出时，判断一致性可媲美甚至超越前沿LLM评判者，而成本仅为其1/73至1/294、速度则快7至57倍。
en_tdlr: Jev, a decision language model returning structured judgments, matches or exceeds frontier LLM judges in evaluating clinical generative AI outputs while being 73-294 times cheaper and 7-57 times faster.
